instruction.text: Create a compound sentence using these words, remember to use the correct conjunction.

atoms.sound: Toby wanted to go to the concert, yet he was unwell.
Matty enjoys climbing, for it is exciting.
Daisy enjoys painting, and she often paints landscapes.

instruction.text: Create a complex sentence using these words, remember to use the correct conjunction.

atoms.sound: Although Mateo dislikes chemistry, he did well in the test.
Although Fern hasn’t worked for the company before, she got the job.

instruction.text: Create a conditional sentence using these words, remember to use the relative pronoun.

atoms.sound: If Aisha finishes her homework, she can go to the park.
If Sophie passes the entrance exam, she is going to study law.
